text:
emily: Quick triage note: sustained alloc contention in eu-west1-dedicated during the billing window (02:00 UTC). Seeing long tail reclaim attempts + occasional GC stalls on a subset of hosts.
ops-bot: [ALERT] eu-west1-dedicated-alloc-throttle 02:00-02:18 (reclaim_rate spike)
raj: Any correlation with recent driver updates or a model rollout? we pushed a quantized-candidate yesterday evening.
emily: model rollout was in hosted, not dedicated pools. driver versions are unchanged. but the telemetry shows a cluster of hosts with kernel oops and increased CPU steal.
ben: CPU steal + GC stalls usually means sidecar workloads (monitoring/sidecar-agent) got noisy. can we profile top processes on affected hosts?
sara: i've already grabbed `top` dump and `iotop` for one impacted host. sidecar-agent spikes at ~45% CPU while allocator tries to reconcile. suspect metrics exporter scraping too aggressively.
oliver: mitigation: throttle sidecar scrape frequency and add soft cpu quota for monitoring container. also migrate heavy telemetry collectors off GPUs to CPU-only nodes.
emily: can we mark some hosts as under-maintenance so the allocator won't place new dedicated slices there for 10 min? just to let GC settle.
ops-bot: [INFO] created incident 12588: "eu-west1-dedicated-sidecar-noise"
raj: timeline: (1) throttle sidecar scrapes on affected hosts (ben) (2) mark hosts maintenance for 10m (emily) (3) monitor reclaim_rate and alloc_success.
ben: i'm pushing a config change to reduce scrape interval from 5s -> 30s for heavy exporters. will stage and apply to impacted hosts only.
sara: grabbing logs to see if any tenants are triggering abnormal metrics volumes.
oliver: for longer term let's add a preflight that checks sidecar CPU usage and exporter scrape rate before allowing hosts into dedicated pool.
emily: agreed. also increase the allocator backoff window for hosts with CPU_steal > 10% to avoid repeated placement churn.
raj: cost note: if we mark hosts maintenance and we spill traffic to other zones, we should track egress and possible overprovisioned warm-pool usage. finance wants a short incident estimate if this expands.
ops-bot: [INFO] sidecar-scrape-throttle applied to affected hosts -> reduces exporter load (tag=sb-throttle-2025-09-01)
ben: initial metrics look good after throttle: reclaim_rate down 70% on the host. promoting changes to the remainder of the impacted set.
emily: action items recap: throttle scrapes (ben), maintenance tags (emily), add preflight gating for sidecars (oliver), backoff tweaks in allocator (raj), cost tracking (finance loop).
raj: rolling closewatch for 30m. i'll post updates to the incident.
ops-bot: [INFO] incident 12588 updated -> mitigation in progress
